definitions.explanation: Describes someone who handles tasks smoothly and efficiently, getting things done quickly and well.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}のいい{仕事|しごと}ぶりだ。
あの{店員|てんいん}は{手際|てぎわ}がいいので、{注文|ちゅうもん}がすぐ{出|で}てくる。
examples.english: That clerk is efficient, so orders come out quickly.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}よく{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}る{姿|すがた}に{感心|かんしん}した。
examples.english: I was impressed by how deftly she prepared the meal.

notes:
PATTERNS:
- {手際|てぎわ}がいい: to be skillful/efficient (predicate)
- {手際|てぎわ}のいい + noun: skillful/efficient ~ (modifier)
- {手際|てぎわ}よく + verb: skillfully, efficiently (adverbial)
- {手際|てぎわ}が{悪|わる}い: to be clumsy, inefficient (opposite)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手際|てぎわ}のいい{仕事|しごと}: efficient work
- {手際|てぎわ}よく{片付|かたづ}ける: to tidy up efficiently
- {手際|てぎわ}よく{進|すす}める: to proceed efficiently

USAGE: {手際|てぎわ} (literally 'hand situation') refers to the skill and efficiency with which someone handles tasks. It is most often used in positive constructions ({手際|てぎわ}がいい), but {手際|てぎわ}が{悪|わる}い (clumsy, slow) is also common.
